meta.note: Company register for the CLIMATRIX India prototype.
meta.coordinates: City-level HQ coordinates. Companies sharing a city are jittered deterministically at render time so markers do not overlap.
meta.revenue: revenue_cr values are approximate, rounded order-of-magnitude figures in INR crore, used only to scale the model. They are not audited financials and must be re-verified before any real use.
meta.margin: Contribution margin fraction, assumed by sector.
meta.evidence: verified = real listed entity; assumed = fictional entity created for this prototype.
